tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /don bsdu ma'i yig sna bzhugs so// gang gis gang gi lus ngag sems dang snying por bcas pa dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /sbyong byed dbang lam lta grub brgyad dang 'bras bur bcas pas legs ston pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma bla mar bcas pa'i zhabs pad gtsug gis rab mchod nas/ /rgyud kun snying po rdo rje'i tshig gi don bsdus tshig don gsal bar bya/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas dngos su dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po rnams sprul pa dang bsgyur ba la dbang thob cing / mtshungs pa med pa'i mthu stobs kyis 'jig rten na ches che bar grags pa rnams btul nas/ log pa'i lam las bzlog cing thub pa'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa zhes grags pa des/ rgyud sde'i zab don bsdus pa rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ thugs kyi sras brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa nag po pa zhes bya ba la gnang zhing / de nas rim gyis snyan nas snyan du brgyud de/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa yon tan du ma brnyes pa zhang dgon pa bas bla ma sa skya pa chen po la gdams ngag ma lus pa gnang zhing / sgrub pa'i lung byin nas lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bka' rgyas btab pa'i lo tshigs thim pa'i dus su/ mdo smad kyi khams pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa' a seng zhes bya bas zhu yig phul nas yi ge zhib pa gcig mdzad par zhus pa la/ sngar snyan brgyud yin pas yi ge zhib par mdzad ma phod kyang don bsdus ma 'di mdzad nas gnang ba yin no/ /'di'i gleng slong ba sho lo ka lnga las/ dang pos bla ma'i gsungs zer gyis mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ spyir shes bya'i gnas dang khyad par du man ngag gi gnad rnams la snang ba thob ces bstan to/ /gnyis pas zhu ba po la bsngags shing gsung bzlog par dka' ba bstan/

gsum pas sde snod dang rgyud sde'i don rtogs par dka' bar bstan/ bzhi pas spyir rtogs par dka' yang grub thob rnams kyis rtogs nas bstan pa'i man ngag las/ phyi rabs kyi so so'i skye bos kyang rtogs par bstan/ lnga pas sngar snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig yin pas yi ge zhib par mdzad mi phod cing gzhung 'di'i don khyed kyi thugs la'ang mnga' bas don bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya'o zhes pa'o/ /de la thog mar snang ba gsum gyis lam gyi gzhi byas te zhes pa'i don ni/ sems nyid rig pa rgyun chags 'di la gnas skabs gsum du snang ba mi 'dra ba gsum 'char zhes ston pa ste de yang / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lam sgom pa'i nyams myong cung zad tsam yang ma skyes kyi bar ni rgyur gnas pa sems can gyi dus zhes bya ste/ de'i dus su las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis rigs drug gi gnas dang / lus dang / longs spyod dang / bde sdug la sogs pa'i snang ba mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'char zhing rang rang gi snang ba la bden par zhen pa ni ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes bya'o/ /zab mo'i lam sgom pas nyams myong cung zad skyes pa nas sa phyed dang bcu gsum man chad du snang ba gang shar nyams kyi snang ba zhes bya ste/ nang gi rlung sems kyi rten 'brel las byung bas so/ /de la dbye na dpag tu med de bshad kyis mi lang ba mtshon ces 'byung bas so/ /rigs bsdu na bco lnga ste/ dgag bya'i sgo nas phye na 'jug sel so gsum/ rten gyi sgo nas phye na lus nyams so gsum/ rgyu'i sgo nas phye na rnam rtog sngon du song ba so gsum/ nang gi rten 'brel gyi sgo nas phye na rlung log so gsum/ ngo bo'i sgo nas phye na/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs so gsum yod/ de'ang bsdu na nyams skyon can brgyad dang / skyon med gsum ste bcu gcig tu 'du/ de'ang bsdu na gsum du 'du'o/ /'gros bzhi thim nas sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba ni dag pa'i snang ba ste/

sngar ma dag pa'i snang ba de lam dus su nyams kyi snang bar 'char la/ de nyid 'bras bu'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su dag par ro gcig tu 'gyur bas/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba tha dad gang yang med de/ dper na chu rlung sna tshogs dang rgya mtshor phyin dus lan tshwa'i ror ro gcig tu rang sar 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar na snang ba gsum ni lam gyi gzhi ste 'og nas ston pa thams cad der 'dus pas so/ /nyams blang ma lus rgyud gsum dag gis shes ces pa ni/ ma dag pa'i snang ba nyams snang dang / de dag tu snang bar byed pa'i thabs sgrub pa pos nyams su blang bya'i tshul ni rgyud gsum ste sbyang gzhi rtogs bya kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ sbyong byed dam rtogs byed lus thabs rgyud/ sbyangs pas rtogs pa phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /dang po kun gzhi'i dngos po ni/ sems rig stong zung 'jug bag chags sna tshogs kyi gzhi'i rten du gyur pa'o/ /de nyid thabs kyi rkyen mchog dman gyi bye brag gis 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhir gyur pas kun gzhi'o/ /de nyid la bdag dang gtso bo la sogs par brtags te/ mdo las/ rdul phran dus dang gtso bo dang / /de bzhin skyes bu dbang bcas su/ /kun gzhi gcig tu dge ba ste/ /rtog pa can gyis ther zug brtags/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de ni rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la shing la shing zho ltar khyab cing / ro gcig pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /de ltar rten dang brten pa gnyis la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sa bon nam nus mthu'i tshul du gnas pas rgyu'am rtsa ba zhes bya ba yin la/ sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad pas rgyud do/ /de ltar na rgyu rang bzhin gyis gnas pa dang / lam nyams su len pa dang / 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med du shes pa ni/ lta ba go ba yin la/ nyams su len pa'i tshul ni logs su shes par bya'o/

/kun gzhi la lhun grub tu gnas pa de mngon du byed pa'i thabs lus la brten nas mngon du 'gyur bas lus thabs rgyud ces bya'o/ /de la bzhi'i dang po rgyu'i dbang ni/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pas dri ma bzhi sbyangs pa'o/ /de la gdan sogs ces bya ba ni dkyil 'khor ste/ sangs rgyas dang rig ma/ byang sems dang lha mo/ khro bo dang khro mo ste/ bsdu na gsum/ phye na drug tshang ba'o/ /de'ang bum dbang gis rgyu tshon nam ras ris la/ sangs rgyas dang rig ma'i gdan dbus su/ byang sems dang lha mo nang gi phyogs mtshams su/ khro bo dang khro mo sgo dang mtshams su'o/ /de dag dngos su ma tshang ba kye rdo rje lha dgu'am mahā ma ya la sogs pa dang / lha dpa' bo gcig pa la'ang gdan gsum tshang bar 'jog tshul ni/ rnam dag dang / 'phrin las kyi sgo nas gdan gsum du 'jog pa yin no/ /de'i go don snga ma ni/ lha de sbyang gzhi phung po la sogs pa dag pa'i cha nas 'jog pa yin la/ phyi ma ni slob ma'i sbyang gzhi de dag sbyong ba'i cha nas 'jog pa yin no/ /dbang gong ma gsum ni/ slob dpon bdag nyid dang / slob ma dang / rig ma dang / dbang rdzas dang bcas pa thams cad gdan gsum tshang bar shes shing bsgom pa dang ldan pa yin la/ khyad par du gsang dbang la/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid yi ge dang shes rab ye shes la lha'i de kho na nyid/ khams bdud rtsi dang / bzhi pa la ye shes kyi de kho na nyid rlung la gdan gsum tshang ba gtso che ba yin no/ /des ni sogs dang po'i don dkyil 'khor gang du zhes pa bstan no/ /sogs gnyis pas ni/ dbang gang thob pa dang / dri ma gang dag pa gnyis bsdus so/ /de'ang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang bcu gcig thob pas gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsum pa thob pas yid kyi dri ma dag

don dam byang sems sam rlung gi dkyil 'khor du bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum char gyi dri ma dag par byas te/ gang zag dbang po rab dbang nyid kyis grol la/ 'bring dang tha ma dbang gis ma grol ba rnams dbang gi don sgom pa'am sgom du rung bar byas pa yin no/ /de bsgom par bya ba ni/ lam sogs nyi shu ste dbang re re la lam/ lta ba/ grub mtha'/ 'da' kha ma/ bar do gang yin pa ste lnga lnga'o/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ni 'dir mi bgrang ste/ thabs kyi skabs yin pa dang / rtsa ba las kyang lam du zhes 'byung bas so/ /bla ma rnams ni 'bras bu dang lnga mdzad do/ /de'i lugs la bar do 'da' ka ma'i zhar byung du bya ste/ 'pho ba thebs na bar do med la ma thebs na de dang 'brel bar dgos pas so/ /de la bum dbang gi lam ni bskyed rim ste/ phyi'i bskyed rim rgyas 'bring gang rung la nang bskyed rim lus kyi lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun zhar byung gi lha nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad cing bsgoms nas/ de la sems bzung / de'ang phyi'i spyan dbu ma'am nang gi dbu'i gtsug tor nas bzung ste/ rim gyis gsal gdab ste gsal na gsal te 'phro gcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro gcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ces pa bsgom pa'i gnad gnyis/ bsgoms pas gsal gdab pa la sogs pa bzhi yis gsal btab cing bsgom/ de las lta ba nyams myong ngo bo nyid gsum skye ba ni/ snang phyogs dang stong phyogs dang zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid do/ /de re re la yang ma rig pa'i snang ba la sogs pa chos can/ yid kun brtags dang bral ba chos nyid/ de gnyis po ngo bo gcig ldog tshul gyis tha dad do/ /nyams de dag mnyam bzhag la skyes na ngos zin par byas la bskyang / ma skyes na rjes thob la rtsol ba'i sgo nas bskyang ngo / /grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba ni/ bum dbang sa drug la 'khor 'das ro gcig tu rtogs pas/

stong gsum yungs 'brur tshud pa la sogs pa'i yon tan 'char ba yin no/ /grub mthas ma rtogs na 'da' ka ma gong du 'pho ba ste/ snang ba bsgyur ba dang 'od kyi gong bu dang sgras 'pho ba gsum gang rung sngar goms par byas nas 'chi ltas byung zhing ma bslus na 'pho ba byed pa yin no/ /'pho ba ma thebs na bar do'i man ngag ni/ sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod pa'i bla ma des bstan pa'i yi dam/ lha las dras pa'i gsang mtshan rnams dang / spyod lam dang / skrag sngangs pa byung ba dang / dus gzhan du'ang dran par byas pas rmi lam du dran na/ bar dor 'jigs pa'i dgra bzhi dang / nyam nga ba'i g.yang gsum ste/ rkyen bdun 'byung zhing bsnam bya'i snang ba byung dus sngar goms pa'i dran pa gsum 'byung bas/ bsnam bya lnga lhag pa'i lhar 'char/ gsang mtshan nas lung bstan pa 'byung bas grub mtha' snyogs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ gsang dbang gi lam ni/ bdag byin brlabs te/ phyi'i phyag rgya la mi ltos par bdag rgyud la rang grub tu yod pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag bsgoms pas/ rang byung gi ye shes skye bas rang byin brlabs zhes bya'o/ de nyams su len pa la khyab byed man ngag gi gnad rlung gi rnal 'byor dang / khyab bya man ngag gi gnad gtum mo'i dmigs pa'o/ /de'ang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bzhed pas/ khams 'dus pa dang po gtum mo drod rtags kyis lam 'khrid pa'i skabs su rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bzhed gsung / de'i rgyu mtshan nam 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'di las las byung zhing / las nyon mongs pa las byung zhing / nyon mongs pa rnam rtog las byung ste/ rnam rtog rlung la brten nas yul la 'jug cing de las chags sdang skyes na las gsog pa yin te/ rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas/ /dbang bo'i lam nas byung nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed/

/zhes 'byung ngo / /des na rlung bsgom pa gnad du che ste/ sems kyi zhon bya rlung zin pas sems ngang gis zin par 'gyur te/ rta bzung na de la zhon pa'i skyes bu ngang gis sdod pa'am/ chu snod bu ga mang po can gyi bu ga gcig bkag pas gzhan la chu mi 'dzag pa bzhin no/ /des na phyi'i 'byung ba thams cad kyis las byed pa'ang rlung gi stobs kyis byed la/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gsum la dbang byed pa'ang rlung yin te/ lnga yi bdag nyid bcu ming can/ /rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed/ /ces 'byung ngo / /de nyams su len pa'i tshul yang phye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / bsdu na ldang 'jug gnas dang bcas gsum yod/ de gsum bsdoms nas bsgom pa srog lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ phyir 'gro ba lam du byed pa la rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas gtang ba shugs bskyed de gnyis ka nas gtang ba kha nas sgra bcas su gtang ba ste gcig nang du 'jug pa'i lam du byed pa la/ rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas dgang ba dang / kha nas sgra med du gtang ba gnyis/ gnas pa lam du byed pa kha sbyor dang gsum mo/ /de yang bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du song nas/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad/ yon tan gang skye/ /skyon gang sel ba ste bzhi bzhir shes par bya'o/ /gtum mo la bsam gyis mi khyab kyang rlung gi rten 'brel la dgongs te nyis khri chig stong drug brgyar 'du la de bsdu na bdun cu rtsa lnga ste/ ā li kā li dang / pu dza u a sogs nyer bzhi/ lte ba'i a thung ste/ yi ge rten 'brel la dgongs/ de'ang bsdu na dgu ru 'du ste/ 'khor lo la ma brten pa'i lnga/ brten pa gnyis dang / man ngag gi gnad la tsaṇ+ḍa li'o/ /de la bdun dang thig le'i rnal 'byor la bzhir phye bas bco brgyad do/ /de rnams kyang rigs bzhir 'du ste/ me 'bar ba la dmigs pa gcer bu tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rtsa'i yi ge la dmigs pa gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li/

khams bdud rtsi la dmigs pa gang ba tsaṇ+ḍa li/ 'bar 'dzag la dmigs pa khyad par tsaṇ+ḍa li'o/ /de la 'dir mar me gso ba tshang pa'i thog 'khor lo gnyis dang bzhi la brten pa rnams khyad par rtsa ba'i rnal 'byor/ srub shing gi 'khor lo gnyis gtum mo/ /thig le bzhi gang ba/ gzhan brgyad gcer bu tsaṇ+ḍa li'o/ /de rnams man ngag gis gnad bsgoms pas nyams myong skye ba ni/ nyon mongs pa rang byung / rnam rtog rang byung / snrel gzhi rang byung / gsal zhing yang la rang byung chen po ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ snying ga'i bha ga'i yig 'bru lngar rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis bdag rgyud la nyon mongs pa rang byung du skye/ gzhan la skyes par mthong / dug lnga 'joms pa'i mthong snang dang / rmi lam 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ ro rkyang gnyis dang / rlung gi rlung la gnad du bsnun pa las rig pa skad cig kyang mi gnas pa 'byung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ khang stong lta bu zhes bya ba sngar rlung sems 'du ma myong ba'i rtsa yig tu 'dus pas rig pa gsal cha med pa gnyid ma sangs pa lta bu 'byung ngo / /tha mal pa'i nyon mongs pa la sogs pa yul rkyen la ltos la/ 'dir rlung sems kyi rten 'brel las nyams snang la shar bas rang byung zhes bya'o/ /de gsum ni nyams skyon can te tha mal gyi nyon mongs la sogs pa dang / khyad par dbye dka' ba dang / lam du srol ma shes na 'khor ba'i rgyu byed pas so/ /man ngag yod pas lam du bsral na skyon med skye ba'i sna 'dren byed pas med thabs kyang med do/ /des na skyon med skye ba la skyon can skye dgos te/ skyon can rang yang skye bar dka'/ ne le 'dzin pa la bya rog 'dzin dgos te/ bya rog rang yang zin pa dka' rje dgon pa ba gsung ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ nyams skyon med de gsal ba sems/ yang ba lus/ sgom pa'i stobs kyis ngang gis 'byung bas rang byung ngo / /'di ni gtso bor sems la 'char ba gsal stong zung 'jug ste dpe'i ye shes zhes kyang bya'o/

/de goms pa las gsang dbang sa bzhi pa grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ rtsa yi ge la dbang thob pas 'gro ba sna tshogs kyi skad dang gsung rab thams cad kyi tshig don thams cad ma 'dres par rtogs la/ de'ang nang gi rten 'brel gcig la tshang zhing rdzogs pas yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /grub mtha' ma snyogs na 'da' ka ma 'od gsal ni/ rang byung gi nyams de nyid bskyang zhing / 'chi kar 'od gsal rang byung rtogs par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa byas nas/ rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'od gsal ngang gis skye la/ de dang bdag gi nyams myong ro gcig tu gyur nas rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur te/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa bzhin no/ /de ma thebs na bar do dgos pas/ gsang dbang gi bla ma dang / lam dang / lta ba gsum dran pa goms pa las bar dor rkyen bdun byung ba na/ dran pa gsum 'byung la bsnam bya lnga yang ā li kā li'i rnam par shar nas rang byung gi ye shes 'char zhing / bar do'i snang ba ma dag pas nying mtshams sbyor ba med par 'gyur ro/ /gsang dbang gi lnga'o/ gsum pa'i lam ni/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ste/ dkyil 'khor ni kun rdzob byang sems kyi/ 'khor lo ni dbab bzung bzlog khyab/ yang dkyil ni bde ba chen po/ 'khor 'dus pa byang sems/ 'khor lo mtshan rtog gcod pa'o gsung / yang na snying po lhan skyes/ 'khor dga' ba gsum/ 'khor lo tha mal gyi nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'o/ /de nyams su len tshul ni/ rgyas bsdus gnyis su gsung yang / nyams su len dus rig ma dag pa/ lus ngag mnyam pa/ byin rlabs mnyam pa/ 'dod pa mnyam pa ste bzhi ni gnyis ka la 'jug la/ khyad par du lam bsdus pa la sbyor ba thur sel dbang du bya ba/ dngos gzhi dbab gzung du bya ba/ rjes bzlog cing khyab par bya ba ste gsum yin no/ /mthar mi nyams par bsrung ba ni 'og nas ston no/ /lam de bsgoms pa'i nyams myong yas 'bab kyi dga' ba bzhi ste/

go rim la ltos pa/ gnas la ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ ngo bo la ltos pa ste bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug go /lam de bsgoms pa las grub mtha' sa bcu gcig dang bcu gnyis pa la bde stong rgya chung ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa bde stong du rtogs pa'o/ /grub mtha' ma snyogs na 'da' ka ma ni/ nam 'chi ba na rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa ste/ rdo rje ni stong pa/ sems dpa' bde ba ste/ de gnyis zung 'jug tu skye'o/ /de'ang lam 'di'i nyams ci rigs pa skyes pa yin na 'chi kar rtsa mdud dral nas thig le dbu mar zhugs/ zhugs dus bde stong skye yang ma bsgoms pas ngos mi zin la/ lam sgom pa rnams kyis rang gi nyams dang 'phrod pas bde stong du ro gcig par gyur nas grol ba yin no/ /de ma grol na bar do ni/ gsum pa'i bla ma dang / lam dang lta ba dran pa yang yang goms pas bar dor rkyen de dag byung dus sngar goms pa'i dran pa 'byung la bsnam bya lnga yang byang sems mu tig gi phreng ba lta bur shar nas/ bde stong mchog tu ro gcig pa'i tshul gyis rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa'i lnga'o/ /bzhi pa'i lam ni/ rdo rje rba rlabs ste/ 'og rlung bskyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs/ ngag 'dren pa zhi drag ngag gi rba rbabs/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ rlung sbyor bdun khyad par du kha sbyor bsgoms pas thur sel la dbang thob par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngag 'dren pa zhi drag gis dwangs ma 'phel zhing brtan par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa'i pad+ma can dngos sam/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dwangs ma 'dren pa'i bye brag gsum gyis/ rtsa gsum la sogs pa sbyangs nas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'gag cing rnam thar sgo gsum mngon du byed pa'o/ /de'ang rdo rje ni lhan skyes kyi ye shes bde stong chen po ste/ mtshan rtog gis mi phyed pa'o/ /rba rlabs ni rnam rtog gi phreng ba ste/

de bde stong du thim pa'i tshul gyis rengs pa'am 'jil bar byed pa ste/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs de nyid du thim pa bzhin no/ /bsgoms pa'i lta nyams ni mas bstan pa'i dga' ba bzhi/ de'i rtags sam phan yon ni/ rgyu mthun pas ni skra dkar 'joms pa la sogs pa ste/ gtso bor lus la 'char ba dang / lus sems gnyis ka la 'char ba dang / sems la 'char ba'o/ /de dag ni 'jig rten pa'i lam du ro rkyang gnyis las kyang gtsor rkyang ma nas log pas 'byung la/ dbu ma nas log pa'i rtags ni/ sa dang po la sogs pa'i rtags rnams yin no/ /grub mtha' ni/ sa phyed la 'khor 'das thams cad bde stong du ro gcig pas rgya che ba'o/ /grub mtha' ma snyogs na 'da' kha ni/ lam phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba ste/ de la sbyang ba goms pa/ las la sbyar ba gsum las/ dang po rlung la sbyang ba zhag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsung yang / mar 'bri ba la nyi shus lnga tshad du 'gyur bas zhe gcig go /de ni grong 'jug gi sngon 'gro yin no/ /sgra la goms pas ni/ bde 'gro dang / gling dang / skye gnas sbyar ba gnyis la dgos pa gtso che'o/ /de gnyis kyi dngos gzhi ni dmigs yul dang sgo yis phye ba'o/ /phyi yi ge la goms pa thams cad dgos la/ nang yi ge la goms pa phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba'i sngon 'gro'o/ /de'i dngos gzhi ni rlung sems dbu mar 'dzud pa ste/ 'dis grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ma thebs na bar do ni/ bzhi pa'i bla ma dang / lam/ lta ba gsum dran pa goms pas bar dor rkyen bdun byung dus dran pa 'byung la/ de bsnam bya lnga yang rtsa gsum du rlung ldang 'jug gnas gsum du 'char/ mthar dbu mar ro gcig tu gyur nas grub mtha' snyogs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa'i lnga'o/ /gsum pa dam tshig la sogs bstan pa las mnyam bzhag gi bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa skyed pa'i rgyu tshogs lam/ rjes thob bzhi skyes pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa sbyor lam drod/

de brtan mi brtan gyis khams 'dus pa gsum la che 'bring chung gsum du bzhag pa'o/ /bza' ba bzhi dang / mi 'bral ba bzhi ni/ mthun rkyen bsten bya yin la/ bsrung ba bzhi ni 'gal rkyen yang bya'o/ /de dag srung thabs bzhis bsrungs pas lam myur du bgrod par 'gyur ro/ /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ bum dbang gi rtsa ltung dang gsum pa'i bsrung bya 'ga' zhig gis srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'dren la/ gzhan rnams kyis lam bgrod pa la 'gor bar 'gyur ro/ /nyams chag bskang ba la/ bskang bya'i yul ni mkha' 'gro lnga/ gang gis bskang ba ni 'dod yon sogs/ ji ltar bskang ba ni mnyes pas sogs so/ /'di'i gzhung la gong ma gsum yod pa'i 'og ma gnyis kyi don/ dang pos phyi'i 'dod yon dang / gnyis pas nang gi 'dod yon bstan pa gsung ba mi 'thad de/ 'dod yon gyi sogs khongs su 'dod yon dang / mnyes pa'i sogs khongs su mnyes pa bsdus pa ga la rigs/ des na 'dod yon gyi khongs su/ lta ba dang / sgom pa dang / tshogs mchod sdud/ mnyes pa'i sogs khongs su tshad du bskyal ba dang tshim par bya ba bsdus te 'di ni gzhung gi don dngos yin par nges so/ /dam tshig nyi shu bskang thabs dang bcas pa/ dbang po 'bring gi lam du mdzad pa ni ye med de gang zag de/ mnyam bzhag bzhi mi sgom zhing lta ba mi skyong ba'o/ /'bring gi lam dam tshig tu gsungs pa ni/ bum dbang gi bsrung ba'i dam tshig la dgongs pa yin te/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /de yis bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de lta ma yin na tha ma dang khyad med par 'gyur ro/ /lam dus kyi dbang ni thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba 'bring gi lam yin te/ bskyed rim rgyas bsdus gang yin yang / ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi rjes la/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab de nas dbang gi lha spyan drangs te mchod bstod gsol gdab bya ba ni/ gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin no/

/dngos gzhi'i tshe dbang blang ba'i yul ni/ rang gi rgyu dus kyi bla ma mi bskyod kye'i rdo rje dang gnyis su med pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga 'khor bcas len pa po ni bdag phyi'i he ru ka lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa'o/ /ji ltar blang ba'i tshul ni/ sngon du shes pa'i cho ga dang rig pa'i dbang rdo rje brtul zhugs rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pa bdag 'jug ltar blang / mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni bdag dang dbang rdzas mi bskyod kye'i rdo rje la sogs phyag gnyis par bskyed do/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gis rjes ma dkyil 'khor dang lha'i dag pa mdor bsdus tsam gsungs bar bsam/ mtha' rten bzhi ni blang mi dgos gsung / len par spro na rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa blang kyang rung ngo / /dbang 'bring du len pa ni/ gtso chung la gal te len na tshigs bcad brjod cing rdo rje dril bu gtad pas dam tshig gsum dran par byed pa ni bum dbang / bla ma yab yum gyis bsgrubs pa'i dbang rdzas tshigs bcad brjod cing gnang ba khong du med pas rnam rtog 'gags shing / rang byung gi ye shes skyes par bsgom pa ni gsang dbang tshigs bcad brjod cing gtad pa'i phyag rgya btang snyoms par zhugs pas lhan skyes mngon du byas par bsgom pa gsum pa/ tshigs bcad kyi don la mnyam par 'jog pa bzhi pa'o/ /rgyas 'bring gnyis ka la cho ga yongs su rdzogs nas dbang gi lha bdag la thim pas rkyen byas te/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo/ /bsdus pa ni/ mngon rtogs rnams su bris pa nyid yin no/ /lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa dgag ces pa ni/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi yin la/ de dbang bzhis sbyangs pas dri ma bzhi 'gags nas sku bzhi 'grub ces pa'o/ /'bras bu'i rgyud la phyag rgya ni/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i dus thams cad du dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pas phyag rgya'i dngos grub bam/

rig ma'i skyes bu zhes bya'o/ /chen po ni de las mchog tu gyur pa gzhan med do/ /de la brjod pa tshig dang / sgom pa dmigs pa dang / myong ba nyams myong dang / rtogs pa dpe dang / mthong pa don dang / grub pa 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po ste/ drug las 'di tha ma'o/ /de'i nye rgyu ni 'bras bu'i dbang bzhi ste 'gros bzhi thim pa'o/ /tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yis spros pa bcad ces pa'i don la gnyis kyi/ dang po la gnyis ngo bo'am mtshan nyid ni/ nang du nges shes khyad par can skyes nas gzhan gyis mos pa dkrog par mi nus pa'o/ /de skyed pa'i rgyu la yang tshad ma zhes btags so/ /de la dbye na bzhi ste/ rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa lung gi tshad ma/ de'i dgongs pa bsdus te bstan pa chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lo rgyus kyi tshad ma/ de'i man ngag bdag la bstan pa ni/ bla ma dam pa'i nyams kyi man ngag tshad ma'o/ /de'i don bsgoms pas bdag rgyud la nyams myong skyes pa ni/ nyams myong rjes su dran pa'i tshad ma'o/ /gang gtan la dbab par bya ba ni rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad do/ /'bras bu gtan la phab nas zhes pa ni/ gtso che bas dngos su smos pa ste/ 'bras bu ste shin tu lkog gyur yin pas/ the tshom dang log rtog gi gnas shas che bas so/ /ji ltar gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ bdag la rgyu lam 'bras bu'i nyams sna tshogs skyes pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi tshad ma gsum dang 'phrod pas nyams dang gdams ngag la yid ches khyad par can skyes so/ /phab pa'i dgos pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing lam myur du bgrod pa'o/ /rtsa ba las 'dir dngos su ma bstan yang 'jig rten pa'i lam du dgos pa la dgongs nas 'og tu bstan no/ /gnyis pa la 'di ni snyan brgyud bzhi ni/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/

mos gus kyis bsam pa tshim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu dus su bla ma las thob pa/ lam dus su rang gis sgom pa/ 'bras bu'i dus su 'gros bzhi thim pa ste/ dbang nyid kyis lam bgrod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang sngags mtha' bzhi'i bdag nyid ste rim pa gnyis 'bad nas sgom pa nyams su blang ba'i mtha'/ de las nyams snang bco lnga la sogs pa 'byung ba nyams su myong ba'i mtha'/ de las phyi nang gi mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlob la/ des nang du drod nyams brtan zhing / phyi rol du nad gdon zhi bar nus pa la sogs pa 'byung ba byin brlabs kyi mtha'/ 'das pa'i lam du grub mtha' snyogs pa ni grub pa'i mtha'o/ /gsum pa ni/ lam sgom pa na lus la na tsha dang / sems la mtho dman sna tshogs byung dus/ gzhan dag skyon du byed pa'ang 'dir bla ma'i man ngag gis nang gi rlung sems kyi 'du 'phro las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin du shes nas bskyangs la lam du 'gyur bas skyon yon tan du slong shes pa'o/ /sha za dang srin po la sogs pa'i mthong snang sna tshogs byung pa na gdams ngag med pa rnams bgegs sam bar chad du 'dzin pas skyon du 'gyur ba las/ 'dir bla ma'i man ngag gis a yig la sogs par rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las byung bar shes nas/ byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyangs pas myur du grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur bas bar chad dngos grub du len shes pa'o/ /yang gzhan dag bying rgod gnyis bsam gtan gyi gegs su byed pa la/ 'dir ting nge 'dzin du shes pas bskyangs na/ bying ba zhi gnas dang / rgod pa lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur bas ting nge 'dzin du ngo shes bas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba'o/ /yang gzugs ston pa la sogs pa bar chad byung na/ sad pa bzhi dang / brda la sogs pas bsrungs pas bar chad las grol te bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel zhes bya'o/ /gnad de dag gzhung 'di nas bstan pas gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa zhes bya'o/

/bzhi pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i tshad ma bzhis/ dbang dus dang / lam dus su bla ma dang lam la mos gus rim gyis 'phel ba dang / mos gus kyis bsam pa tshim pa zhes bya'o/ /des na gsang sngags snyan brgyud ces pa ni/ dbang dang gdams ngag ste/ snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'o/ khongs su byin rlabs dang mos gus bsdus so/ /de ltar snyan brgyud bzhi 'grig cing tshad ma bzhis lam dang 'bras bu la the tshom dang log rtog gi spros pa gcod pa'o/ /ye shes pa lnga yis lam gyi sa mtshams gcad ces pa'i don ni/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid mthar thug rten 'brel te lngas lam thams cad bsdus pas de yis sa mtshams 'byed pa'o/ /de la don bdun gyi rten 'brel 'grig pa'i gzhi ni/ lus khyad par can te/ dkyil 'khor bzhi la skyon med pa ste de la sku bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'o/ /rten 'brel gyi mtha' ni/ ma mtha' rdo rje'i lus skyon med nas/ ya mtha' 'gros bzhi thim pa'i bar ro/ /rten 'brel gyi ngo bo ni gzhan dbang rten 'brel te/ rgyu dus su ma dag pa'i snang ba dang / lam dus kyi nyams snang dang / 'bras bu'i dag pa'i snang ba thams cad rgyu rkyen gzhan la rag las pas gzhan dbang rten 'brel lo/ /lam ni byang chub chen po'i lam ste/ nyan rang gi 'bras bu thabs dman pas 'grub cing phar phyin gyi sa bcu lam lnga yang thabs gzhan gyis 'grub pas/ lam 'di'i tha snyad med do/ /des na byang chub chen po'i lam mo/ /de la dbye na rgyu byang chub chen po sems nyid gnyug ma/ rtsa byang chub chen po dbu ma/ yi ge zung 'jug gi hūm̐/ nyams zung 'jug gsum/ 'bras bu sa bcu gsum pa rnams byang chub chen po'o/ /mdor na sbyang gzhi byang chub chen po de/ lam byang chub chen pos sbyangs nas/ 'bras bu byang chub chen po 'grub pa'o/ /'bras bu 'di las lo rgyus te/ rten 'brel 'di las 'di 'byung zhes man ngag brgyud pas ston pa ste/

ded dpon mkhas pas nor bu lon pa'i lam rgyus ston pa bzhin no/ /des mtshon cing mngon du byas pa'i don ni/ kun gzhi gdod nas dag pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma sbyangs nas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'o/ /rten 'brel du zhig gis lam rdzogs pa ni/ phyi rten 'brel sogs lnga ste chos rje pas mdzad pa las shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni 'khor 'das thun mong gi don bsdus pa ste/ snang ba gsum la sogs pa re rer yang 'khor 'das gnyis ka ston pas so/ /rtsa bar gsum pa sum cu 'dir bstan kyang / de dag 'jig rten pa'i lam du dgos pas der bsdus te ston no/ /'khor lo 'cham pa'i lam gyi don bsdu ba ni/ lam ltar na tshogs sbyor gnyis/ byang chub kyi phyogs ltar na bcu gnyis las/ khams 'dus pa gsum gyis 'dus pa yin la/ de la don gzhan gyis dbang dang 'dir ngag don bsdus te bstan na/ lam gyi ngo bo dang / de'i yan lag can gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khams 'dus pa dang po gtum mo drod rtags kyis lam 'khrid/ bar pa thig le bde stong gi nyams kyis lam 'khrid/ tha ma la skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyis lam 'khrid/ de la ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu ngo bo la sogs pa ston par byed pa sho lo ka phyed dang bzhi ni 'jig rten pa'i lam du shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i gdams ngag bdun dang sbyar te bshad par bya ste/ khams 'du lugs gsum gyis phyogs med du bsral ba'i gnad/ sems gnas lugs gsum gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi nye rgyu shes pa'i gnad/ nyams gsum gyis gang yang ting nge 'dzin du shes pa'i gnad/ drod gsum gyis gang yang byung rgyal du gtang ba'i gnad/ lam 'khrid lugs gsum gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag shes pa'i gnad/ khams 'dus pa gsum gyis lam gyi sa mtshams shes pa'i gnad/ rten 'brel gsum gyis re dogs dang bral ba'i gnad do/ /dang po ni/ 'du lugs gsum dang phyogs med bdun dag gis rnam par phye bas sgro skur bral bar mdzod ces pa'i 'du lugs gsum ni/

ting nge 'dzin gyi ring rgyu gsum ste/ las 'phro can rang gi ngang gis khams 'du ba ni/ bde sdug la sogs pa rkyen gang gis kyang ting nge 'dzin skye ba ste/ rtod mo sa ko rdo rje mtsho lta bu'o/ /mos gus can byin rlabs kyis khams 'du ba ni/ bla ma dang lam la mos gus khyad par can skyes pas ting nge 'dzin skye ba ste/ dbrad mo sa ko ni bzhin no/ /brtson 'grus can 'bad rtsol gyis khams 'du ba na ི/ lam la 'bad rtsol drag po byas pas ting nge 'dzin skye ba ste/ 'chad mo nam mkha' bzhin no/ phyogs med bdun ni/ las 'phro phyogs du sad pas/ rlung phyogs med du log de bzhin du des rlung log des gtum mo'i me 'bar/ des rtsa dral/ des khams 'du/ des zag bcas kyi mngon shes 'char/ des zag med kyi mngon shes phyogs med du 'char bas bdun no/ /phyogs med ces pa ni/ grangs dang tshad med pa'o/ /de bzhin du mos gus dang / 'bad rtsol la yang sbyar bas phyogs med nyi shu rtsa gcig tu 'gyur gsung / /de la dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi ring rgyu/ bar gyi bzhi nye rgyu/ de las nyams myong skyes pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo'o/ /tha ma gnyis 'bras bu ste gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi'o/ /de la nyer gcig po thams cad dang ldan na tshe 'di dang / bcu bzhi dang ldan na bar dor grub mtha' snyogs gsung pa ni mi 'thad de/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la phyogs med nyer gcig 'dzoms mi srid de/ rgyu gsum 'dzoms pa srid kyang / rlung log pa la sogs pa gsum du dbye rgyu med pas so/ /bdun dang ldan na skye ba brgyud nas snyogs gsung pa'ang mi 'thad de/ zag med kyi mngon shes shar na de nyid grub mtha' snyogs pa yin pas so/ /sgro skur dang bral bar mdzod ces pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu dang / ngo bo dang 'bras bu rnams de dag ma yin zhes skur ba dang / de las gzhan yod ces/ sgro 'dogs med par mdzod cig ces pa'o/

/gnyis pa/ gnas lugs rnam gsum rtogs pa yis ting nge 'dzin gyi nye rgyu rtogs par mdzod ces pa sems gnas pa'i rgyu gsum las/ dang po rlung log pas sems gnas pa ni/ sems kyi bzhon pa rlung zin pas sems gnas pa ste/ rta bzung ba'am chu bkag pa bzhin no/ /rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs pas sems gnas pa ni/ rlung gis sbyangs pa'i dwangs ma rtsa gnas su rgyas pas de la brten pa'i sems gnas pa ste/ she'u zho yis rgyal ba bzhin no/ /rten mnyam du 'dres pas sems gnas pa ni/ rten khams dgu'i dwangs ma gzhir gnas pa dam tshig pa dang / bsgoms pas 'phel ba yas byon pa ye shes kyi tshul gyis mnyam du 'dres pas/ shes pa gsal stong la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba'o/ /de dag bdag rgyud la nyams myong skye ba'i nye rgyur shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag la nyams gsum skyes pa yis/ gang yang ting nge 'dzin du mkhyen par mdzod ces pa'i nyams gsum ni/ rlung sems kyi 'phro 'du la brten nas/ ldang ba yang ba dang zo mdog bde ba la sogs pa 'dod pa'i nyams dang / tsha ba dang / grang ba dang / gzer ba dang / smad du 'byams pa la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i nyams lus la skye ba lus nyams/ 'jigs shing nyam nga ba la sogs pa dang / mthong snang sna tshogs dang / gsal stong bde stong sogs 'byung ba sems nyams/ de dag rmi lam du 'byung ba rmi nyams te/ de thams cad ting nge 'dzin du shes par mdzod cig bzhi pa ni/ drod gsum rim pa yin min du skye ba yis gang yang byung rgyal dag tu gtang bar mdzod ces pa drod gsum ni/ rnam rtog sngon du song ba'i drod/ khams dgu 'dus pa'i drod/ thig le 'bar zhing 'dus pa'i drod/ dang po ni/ nyin par gyi mthong thos la brten nas/ sgom byed dus de'i rnam pa blo la shar nas de la sems gnas pa ste/ gzhan dag rgod par byed kyang 'dir ting nge 'dzin du shes par byas te bskyangs pas lam du 'gyur ro/

/gnyis pa khams dgu 'dus pa'i drod ni/ bdud rtsi lnga dang 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs ma gsung yang / de gnyis la khyad par med pas rlung bzhi yis sbyangs pa'i dwangs ma nyid do/ /de dag rtsa yig so so'i gnas su 'dus pas rigs drug gi grong khyer mthong ba la sogs pa nyams snang du ma 'byung ba'o/ /gsum pa thig le 'bar zhing 'dus pa'i drod ni/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis rtsa gnas rnams su dwangs ma 'phel zhing 'dus pas khams 'dus pa dang po la nyi zla la sogs pa mthong ba dang / bar pa la rjes su dran pa drug shes pa dang / tha ma la sprul sku las dbang blangs pas grub mtha' snyogs pa 'byung ba dang / de dag kyang 'jig rten pa'i lam du rgyu rlung sems kyi 'du 'phro la rim pa nges pa med pas drod nyams rnams rim pa yin min du skye bas gang yang byung rgyal du bskyang ba gnad che'o/ /lnga pa ni/ ded dpon lta bu'i khrid lugs rnam gsum gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag rtogs par mdzod ces pa'i don ni/ tshong pa'i ded dpon dang 'dra ba'i lam khrid lugs gsum las rlung gis lam khrid pa ni/ khams 'dus pa dang po la gnod pa skyel ba'i rlung gis lam 'khrid de/ sngar ma sbyangs pa'i rtsa gnas su rlung ma sbyangs ba zhugs pas rtsa rlung gi zug drag po 'byung ste/ dgun gyi rlung grang ba'i reg bya ches che bas sdug bsngal skyed pa bzhin no/ /bar pa la cung zad sbyangs pas phan gnod med pa'i rlung gis lam 'khrid de/ dpyid kyi rlung bu bzhin no/ /tha ma la phan 'dogs pa ste/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs la sogs pa sel zhing / gnyen lcug bzhi 'char ba ste/ dbyar gyi rlung bu bzhin no/ /des rlung zin pa'i nyams ni/ khams 'dus pa dang po la rlung lnga rang gi gnas su zin pa ni/ thabs kyi rgyu ba rags pa'i rlung zin pa ste/ dgu brgya phrag re zin pas phyi rol du du ba la sogs pa'i nyams snang 'char/

bar pa la rlung lnga stobs 'phel bas khams gsum kun tu me ltar 'bar ba la sogs pa'i nyams 'char/ tha ma la shes rab kyi rgyu ba phra ba'i rlung ste/ 'byung bzhi cha mnyam pa dang / 'byung chung bcu drug tu phye ba mnyam du zin pas lha mo sna tshogs kyis mchod pa dang / dri ro sna tshogs kyi nyams 'char/ 'byung chung brgyad las med ces zer ba ni mi rigs te/ 'pho ba gnyis kyi rlung zin dgos la brgyad ni 'pho ba gcig yin pas so/ /gnyis pa khams bdud rtsis lam 'khrid pa ni/ khams 'dus pa dang po la/ khams dwangs snyigs ma phye bas lam 'khrid pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing mi brtan/ bar pa la cung zad dwangs pas sngar bas gsal zhing brtan/ tha ma la phal cher dwangs pas shin du gsal shing brtan te/ gong du bshad pa'i mthong snang rnams 'byung ngo / /rtsa yi ges lam 'khrid pa ni/ khams 'dus pa dang po la yi ge phal pas lam 'khrid pas/ chags sdang lnga dang nyams lnga/ mya ngan sogs ma nges pa 'khrul snang 'char/ bar pa la yi ge bcu bzhis lam 'khrid pas/ 'khor 'das kyi nyams sna tshogs nges pa mthong snang du 'char/ tha ma la yi ge bsam gyis mi khyab pas lam 'khrid pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams can rnal 'byor pa'i nyams la 'char zhing shin du gsal zhing brtan no/ /drug pa ni/ 'dus pa gsum la dpe gsum sbyar ba yis/ /lam gyi sa mtshams the tshom med par mdzod/ /ces pa ni khams 'dus pa dang po gtum mo drod rtags kyis lam 'khrid pa ste/ gsang dbang gi lam gtso che la/ de'i dus su du ba la sogs pa'i mthong snang dang rtsa rlung gi zug 'byung ngo / /bar pa la thig le bde stong nyams kyis lam 'khrid pa ste/ gsum pa'i lam gtso che bas thig le'i zug dang mthong snang brtan pa la sogs ba 'byung zhing / rtsa rlung gi zug zhi nas phan gnod med pa dang / tha ma la skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyis lam 'khrid de/ bzhi pa'i lam bsgoms pas/ dpyod byed med pa'i shes pa/

bde chen ngang gis shar ba'i lta ba/ gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi don mthong ba zhes bya ba 'byung zhing / rtsa dang rlung rnams sbyangs pas nad gdon zhi bar nus pa la sogs pa phan 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /dpe gsum ni gong du bstan pa bzhin no/ /de rnams shes pas rang sa mtshams gang la gnas pa shes par mdzod ces pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ rten 'brel rnam gsum rang la 'dzoms pa yis/ /rgyu rkyen gzhan med re dogs bral bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i don/ rten 'brel gsum ni/ rlung log dang / mthong snang dang / rmi lam gyi rten 'brel gsum/ de lta na de dag gang 'byung ba'i rgyu rang la 'dzoms pa zhes sbyor ro/ /yang na rlung log sogs ces pa rlung log pas sems gnas pa la sogs pa gsum/ de yang drod gsum gyi dbye bas dgu'o/ /lus nyams shugs la bstan te/ de dag 'byung ba'i nang rten 'brel ni/ rlung sems mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu pho brang bzhi la sogs par 'dus shing byin gyis brlabs pas byang chub chen po'i rten 'brel mdzad pa'o/ /des na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi rgyu nang na yod par shes pas phyi rol gyi rgyal ba sprul sku la sogs pa la dngos grub re ba dang / de'i thabs la rtsol ba'i blo sel lo/ /bdud dang sha za srin po la sogs pa'i mthong snang dang / bying rgod dang / lus kyi na tsha dang / sems kyi mtho dman rnams nang gi rten 'brel las byung ba'i nyams snang du shes pas bskyangs na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa lam du 'gyur te/ chu dang zam 'phrang sogs dang 'dra gsung / des na skyon yon tan du slong shes pas sogs sngar bzhin no/ /des na 'jig rten pa'i lam du 'dod pa dang / mi 'dod pa'i nyams ci skyes kyang re dogs spangs te byung rgyal du bskyang ba gnad du che'o/ /gnyis pa lam de'i yan lag la gsum ste/ 'gal rkyen spang ba/ mthun rkyen bsten pa/ thig le'i man ngag go /dang po la bar chad kyi chos bsal ba/

rtsa rlung gi zug bsal ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ gang zag gang la/ dus gang gi tshe/ bar chad gang gis bar du gcod pa dang / de bsrung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rnal 'byor pa/ /gnyis la bar chad 'byung gi gcig la min/ /ces pa gang zag rigs gsum las/ dang po gnyis la bar chad 'byung la/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa la mi 'byung ngo / /gong ma gnyis la'ang / mos pa'am 'jug pas/ thabs shes kyi phyogs su lhung ba dang / nyams kyi lhung ba gnyis gnyis so/ /dus ni 'og nas ston/ dang po lam la 'jug dang zhugs pa dang / /sems zin cung zad brtan dang cher brtan pa'i/ /bar chad rim gyis sel bar shes par bya/ /zhes pa dus bzhi la 'byung ngo / /bar chad kyi ngo bo bzhi bzhi brgyad 'byung la/ de srung ba ni/ srung ba brgyad brgyad bcu drug dag tu 'dod ces pa'o/ /de yang thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa la/ dang po lam la 'jug pa na/ 'jig rten chos kyis bar chad de/ gnyen 'dun dang / mkhan slob la sogs pas khyim nas 'byung ba dang lam sgom pa'i gegs byed cing 'du shes sgyur ba'o/ /de bsrung ba ni zang zing byin la tshig gis sbyang zhing / rang gi dad pa brtan par bya'o/ /lam la zhugs pa na phyi rol gyi bdud kyis lus sems gdung ba'i tshul gyis bar du gcod de/ srung ba'i 'khor lo sngags zlos sngags mdud gsum gyis srung ngo / /sems cung zad brtan pa na/ bdud stobs 'phel ba ste mkha' 'gro phyogs skyong la sogs pas kyang bar chad byed pas/ snang ba sems dang / sems sgyu ma dang / sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa gsum gyis bar du gcad bya dang / gcod byed ma grub par shes pas srung ngo / /sems cher brtan pa na/ ting nge 'dzin ngo mi shes pa ste srin po la sogs pa mthong snang mi 'tshams pa byung ba na k+ṣa yig la sogs pa'i rten 'brel du shes pas srung ngo / /thabs la dad pa la sogs rnams la 'bad ces pa'i don no/

/shes rab sad pa rnam pa bzhi yis bsrung ces pa ni/ gang zag de la bar chad byed pa'i bdud gnyis las/ phyi'i bdud lha'i bu yi bdud ces pa/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha nag po'i phyogs bar chad 'ba' zhig byed cing lam log pa la sbyor ba'o/ /des nyams dang sdug bsngal skyed pa dang / gzugs ston pa dang / sgra brjod pa dang / lta grub brgyad bsgyur ba ste bar chad bzhi byed la/ de srung ba ni/ sad pa bzhi ste/ thun gyi stod smad gang las 'byung rtog pa nyams kyis sad pa/ rang gi lha sgom sgyur ba ting nge 'dzin gyis sad pa/ sngags zlos sgyur ba sngags kyis sad pa/ lta grub dris te sad pa'o/ /sad pa zhes bya ba ni nyams sad byed pa ste/ de yi dam dang / bdud dang / rang gi nyams snang gsum gang yin 'byed pas/ rnam gsum rigs dbye zhes bya'o/ /nang gi bdud la dbang bzhi'i brda yis bzlog /ces pa ni/ zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ste/ rtogs pa brtan zhing brda shes na dngos grub kyang ster la/ min na bar chad byed pa'o/ /des kyang sngar bzhin bar chad bzhi byed pas/ de bsrung ba ni/ dbang bzhi'i brda yis bzlog te/ bla mas ston par 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang gtso che chung gi dbang du byas pa ste/ sad pa bzhi ni thams cad du 'jug la/ phyi'i bdud la'ang brda yis bsrung ba 'jug go /gnyis pa la thun mong bsrung ba bcu bzhi ste/ ces pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i gang zag gnyis ka la dgos pa 'dus la dang po la/ grib ma drug dang / bar pa la thig le 'dzag pa drug tha ma la sgrib pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni dam tshig dang / gdon dang / grogs dang / zas dang / gnas dang / ro'i grib bo/ /de dag las dang po chen po/ bar gyi bzhi 'bring / tha ma chung ngu de dag gis gos pa'i rtags byung na bsal thabs ni/ grib ma chen po dbang gis sel/ 'bring khrus kyis/ chung ngu tshogs kyis sel gsung / gzhan yang sbyin sreg dang / tsha tsha dang /

ngag gi smre bshags dang / lha sgom sngags zlos la sogs pas kyang bsal lo/ /thig le 'dzag pa bsrung ni 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /sgrib pa gnyis ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnam rtog rgyun chags dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa nyams skyon can brgyad de/ de dag bsrung ba'ang 'og nas 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa rtsa rlung gi zug bsal ba ni rtsa zug ni rtsa mdud kyi gnas su rlung sems 'dus pa'i zug yin pas mi 'pho la/ rlung gi rang bzhin g.yo ba yin pas zug kyang 'pho zhing 'byung ngo / /de dag sel ba la/ rtsa'i zug la la dor shin du gces/ /zhes pa ni rtsa de nyid kyi gnas su la dor ba ste/ gang du zug byung ba de'i gnas kyi rtsa'i rnam pa blo yul du byas te/ rig pa rtse gcig tu gtad pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /des ma zhi na mtheb mos mnye ba dang / 'khrul 'khor la sogs pas bsal lo/ /gzhan yang rtsa mdud dgrol ba ste seng ge rnam grol dang / rtsa lam sbyang pa ste/ stobs kyi hūm̐ dang / rtsa sna nyi shu nas 'don pa ste/ yan lag bzhi'i sor mo la rtsa sogs sbubs lta bu bsams te/ de dag nas nad rnams 'thon par bsam zhing drag tu sprug go /rlung gi zug la rngan dgas byin te/ ces pa zug g.yo zhing 'byung na rlung kha nas sgra med du drangs la mnan pas rlung des/ nad la sor gyis 'bigs pa ltar bsnun par bsam zhing yang yang rngubs la mnan/ gtang dus shugs bskyed la bus la gtang / sngar gyi rlung 'thums pa de/ phyi'i rlung des drangs nas 'thon par bsam/ gzhan yang lus khyab par na na bu kha mang po'i sbyor ba dang / nang du ma bde na 'khor lo'i dmigs pa sogs bsgom/ rlung rengs pa la la dor byin gyis brlab/ /bde ba sgom dang rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ /ces pa spyir rlung log pa dang rengs pa gnyis las/ dang po rlung gi 'jug pa bzhi ni/ pho rlung gis 'phar/ mo rlung gis 'dar/ ma ning gi rlung gis brtan/ thod rgal ye shes kyis me 'bar bas/

'phyong rgyug dang / 'o dod 'bod pa sogs 'byung ngo / /'di la skabs su dran pas ma zin na dmigs pas mi phan pas thabs gzhan dgos/ zin na dmigs pa'i steng du 'pho ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'og tu 'pho ba'i gnad gcig yi ge mgo bcad pa dang gsum gyis bsal gzhan gsum ni rigs de ltar shes par bya ba las/ bsal thabs logs pa mi dgos so/ /rengs pa bcos pa la sogs las/ /phyi rlung lus la rengs ba ni/ /rlung sha lus thams cad la zhugs zhing rgyas pa'o/ /de ni bkru ba dang / byug pa dang / lus sbyong ba sogs pas bsal lo/ /nang rlung rtsa la rengs pa ni sngar gyi rtsa la dor nyid yin no/ /gsang rlung sems la rengs pa ni/ srog 'dzin rengs pa ste/ de la 'di gang zhing stong ba/ gzer zhing zug pa/ 'phyo zhing rmugs pa/ 'phyo zhing mi dga' ba'o/ de'i dang po gnyis la/ rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas gtang ba dang / snying dbyung ba dang / bsregs la sogs pa gnad che la/ de yang gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba ste/ snying 'od kyis dgang ba gces/ bzhi pa la gzugs brnyan gnyis dang / khyad par du snying gi nang du bla ma bsgom zhing / de'i byang sems kyis snying gang bar bsgoms na sel lo/ /byin gyis brlab pa ste/ gang na sar bla ma bsgoms te/ gus 'dud byas nas bstim pa dang / yi dam spyan drangs te bstim pa dang / tshogs mchod kyis phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes par byed pa dang / mdo rgyud zab mo lta ba dang yul gyi bdud rtsi bsten pa dang / lus sbyong dang / rdzas dang / sngags dang / dmigs pa rnams ni rten 'brel zab mo ste drug go /bde ba bsgom pa ni/ longs spyod kyi rlabs dang / gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug gnyis so/ /de rnams rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa mthun rkyen bsgrub pa ni/ gdams ngag drug ste/ de la spyir gyi gdams ngag drug dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid kyi gdams ngag drug go /dang po ni/ 'dir mi bstan la/

gnyis pa ni/ lta sgom gnyis la dug dbyung bdud rtsi bsten/ /la dor gdams ngag drug tu shes par bya/ /de la lta ba la ni gnyis ste/ rtogs pa tsam la lta bar bzhag pa dang / nyams myong la lta bar bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas gnas lugs kyi go yul tsam blo la shar ba ste/ de nyid la mos pa'am go ba yul du byed pa'i lta ba/ so so'i gzhung lugs la zhe 'dod kyi lta ba pha rol tu phyin pa dang na mnyam pa'i lta ba zhes kyang bya'o/ /lta ba des ting nge 'dzin mi skye zhing rnam rtog 'phel bar 'gyur bas dug can yin no/ /de rnam rtog rgyun chags kyi dug de dbyung ba ni/ srog rtsol gyi rlung lta bu'i dmigs pa gang rung la sems bzung bas tha mal rnam rtog gi 'jug pa rgyun chad pa ni 'jug pa sel ba/ der 'dzin gyis stong na chags pa gcod pa/ gsal stong zung du chud na byang chub chen po zhes bya'o/ /'di yang rnam rtog yin yang / ched du sgom pa gnyen po'i rnam rtog yin pas yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog ces bya'o/ /de la sems mi zin cing 'phro 'du sna tshogs byed na shes pa yul 'dod pa yin pas/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pas shes pa yul gyis tshim nas sems gnas pa 'byung ngo / /yul bsten pas ting nge 'dzin skye na sems can thams cad la skye bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ ma yin te/ yul rnams gdod nas skye med du gnas pas/ 'ching grol gyi rgyu ma yin te/ skye med du la dor zhing bsten na grol ba'i rkyen byed la bden 'dzin can rnams 'chi ba'i rgyu yang byed do/ /des na yul skye med du la dor/ ting nge 'dzin byung rgyal du la dor/ skye med 'ching grol gyi rgyu ma yin par la dor zhing bsten pas sems gnas pa'i nyams skye'o/ /lta ba'i gsum pa'o/ /bsgom pa bsam gtan gyi gsum la/ bsam gtan gyi dug ni nyams skyon can brgyad de/

ngo bo nyid gsum las/ snang phyogs stong phyogs gnyis/ sgro skur gyis bsdus pas skyon can/ rang byung bzhi la nyon mongs pa dang / rnam rtog rgod pas bsdus la/ snrel gzhi bying bas bsdus pa skyon can/ dga' ba bzhi las dang po gsum skyon can te sred pas bsdus pas so/ /de dag gsum po ni/ 'gal 'dus skyon med gsum ste/ sngar gyi skyon can ting nge 'dzin du shes par byas te/ byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyangs pas skyon med gsum skye'o/ /gal te ma skyes na/ rjes thob la rtsol bas bskyed pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngon du song nas/ me long gi gzugs brnyan nam chu nang gi zla ba lta bu la sbyor ba glod cing 'gyur med du bltas pas yul snang stong zung 'jug gi nyams skye'o/ /de 'gal ba 'dus pa lta bur 'dug kyang / rnam pa blo la snang yang rang gi ngo bos stong par nyams la 'char bas 'gal 'dus kyi skyon med do/ /shes pa gsal stong zung du ma chud na dben pa'i gnas snang ba dang bcas par lus la sogs pa gnad la phab la mig ri thang gi mtshams su blta shing / gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo zhes dran par bya shing / bskyangs pas gsal stong zung 'jug gi nyams skye'o/ /de yang 'gal ba 'dus pa ltar snang yang de'i skyon med pa snga ma bzhin no/ /lus bde stong zung du ma chud na/ longs spyod kyi byin rlabs bsam/ gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug gang rung gis bde stong skye'o/ /de'i 'gal spong yang snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /de dag gis kyang skyon med ma skyes pa'am skyon can yang skyer ma 'dod na/ bdud rtsi bsten pa ni/ zas kyi bdud rtsi la spang bar bya ba/ ri sgog lan tshwa ches pa/ sha rul sum/ chang tsha skyur/ bra zan la sogs rtsub pa'i zas spang / bsten par bya ba bdud rtsi'i rgyun sbyar ro/ /tsong dmar bsten a ru ra sum cu 'o ma bre gang du btsos pas/

gnyer ma sob tsam na/ phye ma 'o ma zho bzhin gyur pa/ tho rangs thur ma re bsten/ a ru ra skabs su mur/ mar bre gang 'o ma bre do/ chu bre bzhi bsres te bsdus bas chu dang 'o ma bskams nas mar lus tsam na phog nas bzhur te/ dar bur dang rang gi khams dang sbyar ba'i sman bsres nas tho rangs khams tshad re bsten na/ khams brtan par byed do/ /yang spang bya'i zas rnams spangs pa'am rang gi dri chen g.yam pa gtsang mar bdal la grib bskam bya/ sbrang rtsi dul ma dang / mar chu cung zad dang bcas te bskol nas chu chod pa dang phog la brtas pa dang / sngar gyi dri chen zhib par btags pa bsres pa'i ril bu ril ma tsam byas la/ tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar yar ngo la gcig nas bco lnga'i bar mar ngo la re re phri nas bsten na lo gcig na rtsa mi mngon par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'bras bu gsum dang / sbrang rtsi'i bcud len la sogs pa'i sbyor bas dwangs ma 'phel bar bya ste rta rdzud sha zad pa gso ba bzhin no/ /rlung gi bdud rtsi ni srog rtsol tho rangs mang du bsgom mo/ /thig le'i bdud rtsi ni mdzod spu sra dkar sa bon bsgom/ dbang gsum pa'i lam bzhin phyag rgya bsten pas ting nge 'dzin skye zhing bogs 'byung ngo / /la dor ba la rtsa dang rlung gi la dor sngar bstan la thig le'i la dor 'og nas ston no/ /bsam gtan gyi gsum mo/ /gsum pa thig le'i man ngag ni/ bdud rtsi bsten pa'am/ dbang gsum pa'i lam bsgoms pas/ de'i nyams bskyang zhing gegs bsal ba ni/ thig le 'bar ba g.yo dang brtan pa ste/ /rnam pa gsum gyis bde stong mchog tu 'gyur/ /ces pa ste/ khams 'dus pa dang por rtsa gnas rnams su dwangs ma 'phel zhing / des nyams skye ba thig le 'bar ba'i drod do/ /'dus pa bar pa la pho brang bzhi la sogs par 'dus pas bde stong gi nyams skye bas g.yo ba'i drod/ tha ma la mig la sogs par thig le 'dus shing brtan pas sprul sku mthong zhing dbang blangs pas/

rlung sems dbu mar 'jug cing zag bcas kyi bde ba mthar thug skye ba brtan pa'i drod ces bya'o/ /de la khams 'dus pa dang po la thig le'i zug dang 'dzag pa bsrung dgos pas de bstan pa ni/ 'bar ba'i mes thig le'i zug 'byung ste/ kha sbyor dag la brtan par gyur pa dang / /dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi yis bzlog pa yis/ /lus la thig le g.yo ba med par bya/ /de la thig le'i zug ni bde ba dang bcas pa 'byung la/ de las thig le 'dzag pa 'byung bas de bsrung ba la/ spyir 'dzag pa'i rigs drug las 'dir bde ba skyes te gang la 'dzag pa bsrung ba ni/ rlung kha sbyor gyis 'og rlung la dbang thob na 'dzag mi srid pas de goms par bya gsang gnas su thig le zin yang ma bzlog na/ nyams par 'gyur bas bzlog pa'i thabs/ dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi ni/ glang chen de dang stag mo ngur/ /gcan zan skyug dang wa ltar sgoms/ /lte ba mgrin pa snying kha dang / /spyi gtsug dag tu rim gyis drang / /ces pa'o/ /kun tu khyab cing brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ /lus la gtun shing 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /ces pa ni/ dkyil krung bcas te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rked par gtad nas lus kun tu bskor ba'o/ /yan lag bzhi yis rlung gi zhags pa 'phangs/ /ces pa ni rkang pa dang lag pa drag tu sprugs pa'o/ /bu chung spyod lam dag gis brtan par bya/ /ces pa bu chung tsog mi thub pa gdan thog tu bzhag pa lta bu'o/ /da ni de dag gi don nye bar bsdus te bstan pa'i phyir/ rje btsun dpal ldan bir+wa pa yi gzhung / /dbang bzhi'i lam la lta grub brgyad kyis bsdus/ /ces smos te/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gsung rdo rje tshig rkang gi don mdor bsdus na/ don drug tu 'du ste/ rgyu rgyud kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa la sa bon nam/ nus mthu'i tshul du gnas pa ni rgyu la gnas pa/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi len pa/

dbang las thob pa/ de'i lam bzhi sgom pa ni lam goms pa/ de bsgoms pas nyams kyi snang ba bco brgyad kyi rtogs pa 'char ba ni/ lta ba la nyams myong skyes pa ste/ de dag ni gtso cher 'jig rten pa'i lam du 'byung ba yin no/ /grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam du 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs pa bzhi yin la/ de'ang sa phyed dang bcu gsum dang / byang chub kyi phyogs nyi shu rtsa lngas bsdus pa ste/ de'i sa mtshams dbang gis phye na/ sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar bum dbang gi sa/ bdun pa nas bcu pa'i bar gsang dbang gi sa/ bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa shes rab ye shes kyi sa/ bcu gsum pa'i phyed dbang bzhi pa'i sa'o/ /lam gyis phye na/ dang po la bskyed rim brtan/ gnyis pa la bdag byin rlabs/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'o/ /bzhi pa la rdo rje rba rlabs bstan no/ /dkyil 'khor gyis phye na/ dang po la lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor/ gnyis pa la rtsa yi ge gsum pa la khams bdud rtsi/ bzhi pa la snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de gsum ni rgyu'i sgo nas phye ba'o/ /zhing khams kyi sgo nas phye na/ sa drug pa sprul sku'i zhing khams la dbang / bzhi longs sku/ gnyis chos sku/ phyed ngo bo nyid kyi zhing khams la dbang / de ni yon tan gyi sgo nas phye ba'o/ /drug pa 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa ni gnyis te/ 'bras bu sgrub pa'i nye rgyu dang / des bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni 'dir tshig kha shas mi gsal dbang ste/ de'i dbang blang ba'i yul ni/ rgyal ba sku gsum tha mi dad ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ /rten ni sa bcu gsum ma la sogs pa mchog thob pa'i bud med do/ /dbang rang gi ngo bo ni rten dang thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa las khams dwangs ma'i dwangs ma mkha' gsang du mngon du byas pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis drangs te lte ba la sogs par 'dir tshig kha shas mi gsal dran pa'i tshul gyis/

thabs rgyud dag pa gsum dang / shes rab kyi rgyud dag pa gsum so sor dag pa gcig ste/ bdun gyis gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags ma lus pa sbyangs nas/ rnam thar sgo gsum mngon du byed pa'o/ /de'ang skad cig ma dang po drug ni bar chad med pa'i lam ste/ de nyid la srod kyi dus dang / bdud btul ba dang / cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa chung ngu dang / 'bras bu gnyis kyi dus la sogs pas bstan no/ 'dir tshig kha shas mi gsal pa'o/ /de'i rtags ni sa g.yo ba dang bdud gnas su sgra grags pa dang / bha ga'i thig ler khams gsum mthong ba dang / mkha' 'gro rnams ring nas 'du ba dang / dbang phyug gi don brgyad 'char ba la sogs pa'o/ /skad cig ma bdun pa ni rnam grol gyi lam ste/ de nyid la tho rangs kyi dus dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / sangs rgyas gsar pa zhes pa dang / 'bras bu gcig gi dus zhes bya'o/ /lam des bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ni/ lus rtsa gnas gyur sku thams cad pa sprul pa'i sku/ ngag yi ge gnas gyur gsung thams cad pa longs sku/ khams bdud rtsi gnas gyur thugs thams cad pa chos sku/ snying po ye shes rlung gnas gyur sku gsum tha mi dad pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ de dag ni ldog chos kyi sgo nas so sor phye ba ste/ rten gnas gyur gyi sku bzhi'o/ /brten pa sems gnas gyur pa shin du rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ de ni thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu'o/ /de'ang rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas so/ /de dag nyid ye shes lnga'i ngo bo ste/ sprul sku bya ba grub pa/ longs sku so sor rtog pa/ chos sku mnyam pa nyid/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam dag me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de ltar sku dang ye shes lhun gyis grub cing / rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa ste/ 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa'am/

phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ces gsungs pa yin no/ de nas sh+lau ka gcig gi don ni/ sngar bstan pa'i re dogs dang bral ba'i lam dang / snyan brgyud bzhi'i skabs su bstan pa nyid de/ mdor na gdamasangag gi rgyal po ngo shes/ gegs sel gyi rgyal po byung rgyal zhes bya ba yin gsung ngo / /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis sngar bstan pa'i tshad ma bzhis gtan la phab cing nges shes bskyed nas/ gdams ngag drug gis tshul gyis nyams su blangs na tshe 'di'am bar dor grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur te/ gal te rnal 'byor pa de brtson/ /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'das/ /de bzhin lus 'di spangs ma thag /brtson pa mi ldan pas kyang 'grub/ /ces 'byung ngo / /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis khengs pa bskyung ba/ de nas gnyis kyis sngar snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig yin pas yi ge zhim mo mdzad ma phod ces pa dang / de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis bzod par gsol ba'o/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i zab don legs bsdus ming don rjes mthun lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi /rnam 'grel thog ma tshig nyung don rgyas don bsdu ma zhes grags pa'i tshig don gsal byed 'di/ /bslab gsum rin chen dge legs gter dang zab don ting 'dzin de 'bras bzang po ldan pa yis/ /nye bar bskul nas gus pas sbyar 'dis 'gro kun smon gnas lam lnga'i mthar thug thob par shog/ //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 24 kun dga' smon lam/ don bsdu ma'i yig sna/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 25
